description: Java source code for an Android activity demonstrating the use of status bar notifications including creating, updating, and canceling notifications with various styles and behaviors.

classes.name: StatusBarNotifications
classes.description: An Android Activity class that demonstrates creating and managing status bar notifications with various styles and actions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the user interface, and attaches click listeners to buttons for various notification actions.

methods.name: makeMoodIntent
methods.description: Creates a PendingIntent that opens NotificationDisplay activity with an extra indicating the mood image.

methods.name: makeDefaultIntent
methods.description: Creates a PendingIntent with a stack of intents for deep launching into the app.

methods.name: setMood
methods.description: Builds and posts a notification with a specified mood icon and message, optionally with a ticker.

methods.name: setMoodView
methods.description: Creates a custom notification with a RemoteViews layout and posts it.

methods.name: setDefault
methods.description: Posts a notification with default sound/vibration settings.
